These are the last two camps controlled by the army in the Kidal region, since the Fla separatists and the Jnim jihadists, linked to al-Qaeda, seized Kidal and Tessalit last April On the evening of October 4 and the morning of October 5, air strikes were carried out in the area. The army has not disclosed its intentions, but these movements could foreshadow the beginning of a reconquest operation.

latest_events.title: Mali: towards a major FAMa offensive in Kidal against the Fla and JNIM
latest_events.summary: Major troop movements and a series of strikes around Kidal revive questions about the intentions of the Malian Armed Forces in the north of the country. A new operation against the Fla and JNIM positions could emerge, even if the army has not yet announced any reconquest offensive . More than 200 vehicles arrived Saturday in Anéfis, Kidal region, while another convoy of about 80 vehicles reached Aguelhoc on Sunday.

latest_events.title: Koutiala: positions of armed terrorist groups targeted and hit by FAMa
latest_events.summary: Bamako, October 04 (AMAP) The Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), supported by their partners, targeted and struck, on Saturday, October 3, 2026, several entrenchment points of armed terrorist groups, located about 40 kilometers south of Koutiala, says a statement from the General Staff of the Armed Forces . According to the same source, the exploitation of precise intelligence has made it possible to locate several positions housing armed terrorist groups as well as war materials, including many armed vehicles.
sources: AMAP (Agence Malienne de Presse et de Publicité)

latest_events.title: Mali: at least 3 Russian soldiers and 4 paramilitaries killed in a jihadist attack
latest_events.summary: Mali: at least 3 Russian servicemen and 4 paramilitaries killed in jihadist attack At least three Malian servicemen and four Russian paramilitaries of Africa Corps, were killed Sunday when their convoy fell in a jihadist ambush in the center of the country, AFP learned Tuesday from security and local sources This new assault comes amid an upsurge in attacks by jihadists from the Al-Qaeda-affiliated Support Group for Islam and Muslims (JNIM) in the Sahelian country, which has been in conflict since 2012.
